d: A young woman is stalked, but her cry for help is ignored. An estranged husband threatens to kill his wife.
A camera hidden in a bag of chocolates solves a murder, and a gloating social media post entraps a killer.
Police investigate the disappearance of a 5-year-old boy, and a young girl's body is discovered in a field.
Two women are killed, and all evidence suggests their husbands are involved with their untimely deaths.
A woman goes missing with a large sum of money. In the UK, the shocking murder of a woman sparks outrage.
A man and his accomplice go on a killing spree, leaving four dead. In the UK, a student is stabbed to death.
A couple hiking in a national park must fight for their lives when they're attacked by a ferocious mountain lion. A young mother and her cousin are shot by a deranged gunman.
After being abducted at knifepoint and gang raped, a seven month pregnant woman has her throat cut and is left to die.
An armed robbery on a Mexican beach escalates into a horrifying sexual assault for a California couple.
Wayne and Mary woke up to find their farmhouse surrounded by a cloud of lethal chlorine gas following a rail derailment. Thus began a harrowing six-hour ordeal until emergency services arrived.

Women are most often assaulted by someone they know.  Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender.  Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars.  Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up.  As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.
In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast.  The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.
In 1980 the FBI faced the largest explosive device they had ever seen.  The bomb was sophisticated, carefully constructed, and designed to destroy an entire building.
In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta.  The streets erupted in mob warfare.  Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death.  Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions.  Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?
Wrongly convicted, David Milgaard spends 20 years in prison before DNA evidence proves his innocence and reveals the real killer.
